test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

We will leave __towards__ 6.00 a.m.
solution:
The correct answer is "**at**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the usage of the preposition "**towards**" is **incorrect**.
 
• We need to use the preposition "**at**" in the given sentence.
 
• The preposition "**at**" is used before **specific times of the day.**
 
• The preposition **"at"** is also known as the **preposition of time.**

**​The correct sentence is:* ****We will leave **at__ **6.00 a.m.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
